data.description: Marker attribute. Put on any element to replace its content with a shimmering placeholder. Remove or set to 'off' when real content is ready.

data-aed-skeleton.description: Variant. Empty / 'block' = rectangular default. 'line' / 'circle' = preset shapes. 'text' = multi-line paragraph. 'off' = disabled (keep the attr for easy toggling).
